race.comment: COCOS DESIRE (7) comes through the Breeders Challenge 3F series where she placed behind the flying Ark Sea in the semis before a decent effort for fifth to that same filly in the final. She'll enjoy this class drop. HUNTER STRIDE (1) has been in the placings in all five runs this prep and went well again last start at Penrith, finishing third and 2.2 metres from the winner. No excuses from this advantageous draw so could break through. DUTTON (2) is back from a let-up but enjoys a big class drop after a fifth to Eureka favourite Loucasso last start won from a wider barrier than this three back at this circuit and distance. THE EYE IN THE SKY (8) can feature with some luck from a wide draw.
